name: padded
_deep_note: Returns deep (deep_bell) as a coat of spider silk (floor 43 on) or elven silk (66 on). Brandon's defence-model decision 20 (2026-11-17): a Dexterity hero finds light and medium armour all the way down; it keeps the template's lower AC (the trade for the dodge and the speed).
_design_note: F1-5 starter; chained with leather material gives +1 AC contribution.
lore_template: A padded coat of {material_name}, quilted thick and stitched in offset rows. It is cheap, quiet and forgiving, and for most squires it is the first real armor they own.
forms_note: Quilted layers soak a club the way a mattress takes a punch, and dull an edge a little.
